title: Robust coherent Grover search: square-root work with linear DCP samples

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, let n=ceil(log2 N). Algorithm RCG-1/4 in proof.md uses q=128(n+1) retained source registers, threshold r=q/4, an m=n+3 qubit candidate register with L=2^m labels, and exactly k=isqrt(9*2^(n-1)) coherent Grover iterations. Under the fixed-batch marginal replacement model in proof.md Section 2, at most floor(q/4) positions are malformed and the complementary joint marginal is exactly the product of ideal rho_s states; arbitrary correlations with malformed registers are allowed subject to that marginal. It recovers the full s with unconditional probability strictly greater than 5/6. All four resource bounds hold jointly on every branch for this same algorithm and configuration, uniformly over N,s and every allowed joint input state. Total charged work is O(sqrt(N) n^2 log2(n+2)), including all sample acquisitions, exact Clifford+T gates, circuit generation, classical preprocessing and bit operations, indexed accesses, final measurement and output. A supported asymptotic envelope for n>=2 is B_T(n)=2^(n/2) n^2 log2 n, whose growth index is exactly 1; the operational bound includes n=1.

The guaranteed malformed-sample fraction is epsilon(n)=1/4 under the exact model in proof.md Section 2 and the structured error_model. Full-secret success and all four resource bounds hold uniformly for every permitted subset and joint state. This is a fraction of the acquired batch, not a per-copy probability; it includes clean inputs and makes no claim of an optimal threshold.

structured.error_model: Fixed-batch marginal replacement model: before measurements the Q acquired (n+1)-qubit registers have a fixed joint state omega. There exists an unknown fixed subset B of at most floor(epsilon(n)*Q) positions whose complementary joint marginal is exactly the tensor product of ideal rho_s states. The state on B and its correlations with other registers are arbitrary subject to that marginal, may depend on N and s, and may include invalid residue basis states. No source adaptation to measurement feedback is allowed. All registers, including B, count toward Q.
